title: MES Developer
description:
MES Developer

Brazil/Argentina

Contract


Key Accountabilities:

  • This role will provide you with the opportunity to lead key activities to make progress in your career, these responsibilities include some of the following:
  • Participate in requirements gathering to solidify requirements and determine the best technical solution to meet the business needs.
  • Develop and implement new templates, components, and responsive web pages/sites and support client development and security standards while developing.
  • Work in the Manufacturing organization on the implementation of new capabilities.
  • Carry out the development of the assigned project adhering to the engineering standards/best practices, committing to the agreed timeline, and ensures quality metrics are met.
  • Integrate internal and/or external applications/ERP using middleware.


Key Qualifications and Experience

We are seeking an experienced Developer with strong expertise in GE Plant Applications to design, develop, enhance, and support Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with SQL, .NET technologies, and Web Services, and will work closely with manufacturing, quality, and other cross-functional teams to deliver reliable and scalable design to enhance current MES/Quality solutions that support shop-floor operations.

  • Strong hands-on experience with GE Plant Applications.
  • Proficiency in writing Stored procedure, Functions and other SQL Server related codes. (T-SQL, performance tuning, database design)
  • Experience with .NET technologies (C#, ASP.NET, Web API, Windows Services)
  • Solid understanding of Web Services (REST and/or SOAP)
  • Experience with UI design – HTML/Thingworx/ReactJS
  • Strong hands-on experience with reporting capabilities – SSRS/PBI and others.
  • Experience integrating MES with ERP systems (SAP preferred)
  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes and shop-floor systems
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams
  • Experience designing and optimizing relational databases and stored procedures for optimal performance and/or maintainability.
  • Experience with version control systems (Azure DevOps preferably)
  • Exposure to Agile/Scrum development methodologies.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Strong financial operations don’t just track performance, they drive it. We’re looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.

We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That’s where you come in.


The Role

This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.

You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.

This is not a purely back-office role, you’ll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized
  • You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
  • You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
  • You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership
  • You struggle with deadlines or process improvement
  • You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment


What You'll Do

Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close
  • Prepare financial statements and reports
  • Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records

Month-End Close & Process Improvement

  • Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days
  • Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows
  • Build scalable processes and documentation

Team Oversight

  • Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work

Cost & Inventory Accounting

  • Manage and apply landed costs across products
  • Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility

Reporting & Analysis

  • Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making
  • Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking


Requirements

Must have:

  • 1+ year of experience in ecommerce or DTC
  • Experience managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and organization

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Flexble

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy


Ready to Apply?

If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

  • You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized
  • You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
  • You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
  • You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership
  • You struggle with deadlines or process improvement
  • You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment


What You'll Do

Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close
  • Prepare financial statements and reports
  • Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records

Month-End Close & Process Improvement

  • Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days
  • Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows
  • Build scalable processes and documentation

Team Oversight

  • Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work

Cost & Inventory Accounting

  • Manage and apply landed costs across products
  • Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility

Reporting & Analysis

  • Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making
  • Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking


Requirements

Must have:

  • 1+ year of experience in ecommerce or DTC
  • Experience managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and organization

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Flexble

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy


Ready to Apply?

If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

description:

Acendeo is looking for a hands-on n8n Automation Specialist to build, scale, and evolve our internal automation infrastructure. You’ll use n8n to integrate CRMs , eMail systems , third-party APIs , and AI tools powering our growth engine and operational workflows.


This is a cross-functional role where technical depth meets business impact. You’ll be creating automations that streamline lead generation, enrich data with AI agents, and enhance visibility across systems. A1 Beginner

A2 Elementary

B1 Intermediate

B2 Upper-Intermediate

C1 Advanced

C2 Proficient

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


We’re looking for a detail-oriented Accountant to support our client with day-to-day accounting operations, financial reporting, and reconciliation processes within NetSuite. If you have strong experience managing financial data, ensuring accuracy across accounts, and working within a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable processes within NetSuite
  • Prepare and record journal entries, including accruals and adjustments
  • Perform bank and credit card reconciliations and resolve discrepancies
  • Maintain and reconcile general ledger accounts to ensure accuracy
  • Support month-end and year-end close processes
  • Generate financial reports and assist with basic financial analysis
  • Review transactions for accuracy, completeness, and compliance
  • Collaborate with internal teams to clarify financial data and resolve issues
  • Ensure financial records are organized, accurate, and audit-ready within NetSuite


Who We’re Looking For:

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Minimum 3+ years of accounting experience
  • Experience supporting US-based clients or working in a BPO/outsourcing environment is preferred
  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite and proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently
  • Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages


Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Competitive Compensation

We offer a monthly salary starting at USD 1,200 - 1,600 , with flexibility for higher compensation based on your experience and qualifications. This is a full-time role requiring a 40-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


✈️ Paid Time Off and Sick Leave:

We believe in work-life balance. Enjoy generous paid time off and sick leave policies, allowing you to recharge, travel, or rest when needed—all while knowing your role is secure.

title: Analista de Endpoint Security Pleno - Trend Micro
description:
A NTT DATA Inc. é uma empresa multinacional de tecnologia que integra, dentre seus serviços, o desenvolvimento de software, segurança, cloud e, principalmente, infraestrutura de TI. Estamos, segundo o Great Place to Work, dentre as melhores empresas de Tecnologia para se trabalhar no Brasil. Temos uma cultura de trabalho inclusiva e prezamos muito pela liberdade de melhorar processos, pela flexibilidade e pelo respeito às pessoas!


Analista de Endpoint Security Pleno - Trend Micro


Formato: Remoto

Horário: Atuação em Escala - 23:00 às 07:00


Buscamos uma Pessoa Analista de Endpoint Pleno especializada na segurança de ambientes legados.


Work Experience

Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Gestão técnica de políticas de exceção e proteção para sistemas legados, minimizando a superfície de ataque de ativos que não recebem patches do fabricante.
  • Implementar Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) e IPS em ambientes obsoletos;
  • Gerenciar políticas de senhas e criptografia compatíveis;
  • Atuar na correção de configurações incorretas.


O que esperamos que você possua?

  • Experiência em remediação de vulnerabilidades em sistemas descontinuados;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de segurança com suporte a legado.


Certificações:

• Trend Micro Certified Professional for Deep Security

• CompTIA Security+


Benefits

O que nós oferecemos?

  • Vaga remota
  • Contratação modelo CLT
  • Seu equipamento de trabalho

title: Especialista em Programas
description:
Objetivo da Posição

Atuar de forma estratégica na gestão de programas , com foco na administração de recursos, mudanças de fornecedores e interface direta com a área de Compras , garantindo o cumprimento de prazos, qualidade, viabilidade financeira e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.

Buscamos um profissional autônomo , com forte capacidade de autogestão , visão crítica e interesse genuíno em evoluir para posições de gestão.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de programas e dos recursos alocados;
  • Liderar mudanças de fornecedores em parceria com a área de Compras;
  • Interface com áreas multidisciplinares: Compras, Tecnologia, Vendas e Fornecedores;
  • Planejamento, acompanhamento e controle de cronogramas;
  • Negociação de prazos internos e externos;
  • Análise de viabilidade financeira das propostas;
  • Atuação preventiva na identificação e mitigação de riscos do programa.


Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia;
  • Inglês Avançado obrigatório
  • Experiência comprovada na área de Engenharia;
  • Conhecimento em FMEA e APQP;
  • Vivência com MS Project;
  • Conhecimento financeiro para:
  • Análise de custos;
  • Avaliação de viabilidade econômica de propostas.
  • Experiência prévia no setor automotivo.

description:
Job Title: Senior SRE

Location: Remote –LATAM (must work EST hours )

Shift: EST business hours

Duration: TBD (long‑term)

About the Role

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Sobre a Arvo

Temos o propósito de tornar a saúde no Brasil mais acessível para todos. Nossa jornada começa com o uso de dados e inteligência artificial para reduzir fraudes, abusos e desperdícios em pagamentos de saúde. Acreditamos que a única maneira de alcançar isso é através de um time incrível, com pessoas apaixonadas por saúde e compradas na nossa missão de transformar o setor.


Perfil desejado

Buscamos uma liderança técnica com alta autonomia e visão sistêmica. Você não apenas escreve código de excelência, mas atua como um multiplicador, influenciando o roadmap técnico e garantindo que nossas soluções sejam resilientes e seguras por padrão.

Você deve ser um entusiasta da eficiência, utilizando ferramentas de IA e agentes para acelerar o ciclo de desenvolvimento, permitindo que seu foco esteja na resolução de problemas complexos de arquitetura e estratégia de dados.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderança de Arquitetura: Guiar a concepção e evolução da plataforma Audit Copilot, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e rastreabilidade em todo o ecossistema.
  • Impacto Cross-Team: Atuar além do próprio time, identificando dependências, mitigando riscos técnicos e garantindo que as integrações com os times de Dados sejam fluidas e performáticas.
  • Excelência Operacional: Definir e zelar por padrões de confiabilidade (SLOs) e observabilidade, transformando aprendizados de incidentes em melhorias sistêmicas para reduzir o toil.
  • Mentoria e Cultura: Elevar a barra técnica da Arvo, mentorando engenheiros, promovendo revisões de design críticas e disseminando boas práticas (TDD, CI/CD, Clean Architecture).
  • Parceria Estratégica: Colaborar com Produto para refinar o escopo técnico de iniciativas ambíguas, equilibrando trade-offs entre velocidade de entrega e dívida técnica.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Formação em engenharia de computação ou ciência da computação ou possuir experiência prática nessas áreas
  • 7+ anos de experiência com desenvolvimento e arquitetura de software
  • Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura e boas práticas de código tais como SOLID, Clean Code Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, Layered Architecture, etc.
  • Experiência com algum cloud provider (GCP, AWS, Azure, etc.)
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (Postgres) e não relacionais (Redis)
  • Uso de ferramentas e agentes de IA (ex: Cursor, GitHub Copilot, LLMs para automação) para agilizar a codificação, testes e documentação.


Qualificações Desejadas

  • Experiência com pipeline de processamento de dados
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Go e Python
  • Experiência com terraform e IaC, Kubernetes (recursos básicos, kubectl)
  • Experiência com GCP


Benefícios (modelo de contratação PJ)

  • 13º salário: proporcional aos meses trabalhados no ano
  • Férias remuneradas: 22 dias úteis
  • 1/3 adicional de férias
  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco Saúde Nacional II (TNMI)
  • VA/VR: R$1.080 no Flash
  • Acesso ao wellhub (gympass)
  • Vaga remota

description:
Se você gosta de desafios e quer mostrar todo o seu potencial, queremos te conhecer! A Vericode preza por um time inclusivo e repleto de diversidade, nas suas mais variadas representações. Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência!


#VemSerVericoder


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Diagnosticar e corrigir problemas em scripts de testes automatizados;
  • Elaborar cenários de testes;
  • Documentar e revisar a documentação de projetos de testes automatizados;
  • Identificar e registrar defeitos encontrados durante os testes;
  • Gerar evidências claras e precisas dos resultados de teste;
  • Reportar o status das execuções, identificar defeitos e comunicar impedimentos.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida em programação com JavaScript;
  • Proficiência no uso do Cypress para automação de testes;
  • Proficiência em Bruno APIClient ou Postman;
  • Conhecimento prático em Cucumber para desenvolvimento orientado por comportamento (BDD);
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Experiência no trabalho com bancos de dados e SQL;
  • Domínio de BDD para criação de testes automatizados baseados em comportamento.


Benefícios:

Reembolso de Capacitações Técnicas: Cobertura de 100% para certificações profissionais, além de reembolso para cursos de capacitação técnica;

title: Support Team Member
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Support Team Member .

In this role you will:

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (Regulatory Operations, IT Security, QA, Validation) to meet compliance and audit readiness.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation, including SOPs, user manuals, knowledge base articles, and incident logs.
  • Participate in validation testing (IQ/OQ/PQ) and periodic system reviews within GxP-regulated environments.
  • Assist in system upgrades, patch testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to support uninterrupted business operations.
  • Proactively identify and drive opportunities for process automation, system optimization, and user experience enhancements.
  • Troubleshoot critical production issues, including system unavailability and data integrity issues, and propose resolutions or workarounds.
  • Ability to replicate & diagnose issues using industry-standard tools and techniques (e.g., FTP, Postman, AWS Tools), and propose resolutions or workarounds.
  • Provide end-to-end support (L1–L3) for Veeva RIM and Veeva SafetyDocs platforms, including issue diagnosis, resolution tracking, and proactive system monitoring.
  • Veeva API: Collaborated with the BOT development team to provide Veeva RIM API endpoints to facilitate automation and system integration.
  • Learning Management Coordinators: Contributed to the setup of the Veeva RIM Trainings module within the eLMS Quality Suite, enabling streamlined training compliance track.
  • PleaseReview: Serve as a technical point of contact for both Standalone and Veeva-integrated PleaseReview applications, managing user access, configuration, and performance optimization and licenses management.
  • ISI Toolbox: Support the setup and maintenance of ISI Toolbox, ensuring accurate installation, patching, and integration with other internal systems.
  • Lorenz docuBridge: Manage the full lifecycle of Lorenz docuBridge, including user provisioning, license management.
  • Lorenz iSubmit: Support the installation, configuration, and issue resolution of the iSubmit application, ensuring compliance with internal and external submission standards.
  • Word Templates: Worked configuration and of the Starting Point Template application used in regulatory document workflows.
  • iLovePDF: Install, configure, and troubleshoot iLovePDF and other auxiliary document processing tools for high-volume regulatory submission tasks.
  • ServiceNow: Be responsible for Request and Incident tickets and/or customer escalations and drive progress until resolution.

Mandatory Skills:

  • Fluent English.
  • Experience with the life science and healthcare industry.
  • Knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11 and validation processes in a regulated environment.
  • Strong technical skills in configuration, and issue resolution in Windows-based enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow) and Request/ incident/change management processes.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across global, cross-functional teams.
  • Experience with documentation tools and version control systems is a plus.

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
We are hiring on behalf of our client, a global leader in the meal kit delivery industry that helps millions of customers cook healthy, homemade meals without the stress of meal planning or grocery shopping.


As part of Zoolatech’s distributed engineering team, you will join the Market Innovation team - a fast-moving internal innovation group focused on building and delivering new product initiatives across multiple domains and services. Unlike traditional product teams, this team operates across different repositories, architectures, and backend ecosystems, taking ownership of complex discovery-driven projects from investigation to MVP delivery.


By joining Zoolatech, you will work closely with senior engineering leadership and global stakeholders in a highly autonomous environment that values ownership, adaptability, strong communication, and engineering curiosity.


Responsibilities


  • Investigate and understand existing backend services and distributed systems
  • Design and implement backend solutions primarily using Golang
  • Work on MVP delivery from technical discovery through implementation
  • Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders across multiple domains and teams
  • Communicate technical findings and proposed solutions clearly
  • Adapt quickly to new codebases, services, and technologies
  • Contribute to scalable and maintainable backend architecture


Skills Required

  • Strong commercial experience with Golang
  • Strong background in backend development, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience building event-driven architectures using messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS/SNS
  • Solid understanding of testing practices, including unit and end-to-end testing
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases
  • Ability to quickly understand and navigate unfamiliar codebases and services
  • Strong problem-solving and backend investigation skills
  • Good communication skills and ability to work independently
  • English level sufficient for direct communication with international teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Python
  • Familiarity with MongoDB, Elasticsearch, GraphQL, or JVM languages
  • Experience working in fast-paced MVP or startup-like environments


Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully)

This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider.

To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country.

Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment


Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

title: VEXOS Platform Manager (Remote)
description:
We're Hiring | VEXOS Platform Manager

Remote · Full-Time | Based in Brazil


The Render Pros is the presales creative engine behind some of the most ambitious real estate developments in the world. We build photorealistic visualizations, immersive digital experiences, and VEXOS — our proprietary presales platform that transforms how developers market and sell high-value assets before they're built.


We're growing and we need a sharp, reliable operator to help us run VEXOS smoothly.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


About The Render Pros / VEXOS


We are a vertically integrated presales studio. Our clients are real estate developers, luxury asset companies, and investment groups working on projects across the Western hemisphere. VEXOS is our platform product — a fully branded, data-driven presales environment that combines 3D visualization, buyer engagement tools, and lead intelligence. We define the strategy. You help us execute it.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


The Role


The VEXOS Platform Manager supports the delivery and day-to-day management of VEXOS client deployments. You will work closely with our Visualization PMs, development team, and founder to keep projects on track and clients well-supported.


You are organized, communicative, and detail-oriented. You follow process, flag issues early, and represent the platform professionally to clients. You execute the vision — you don't set it.


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


✅ What You'll Be Responsible For


• Coordinating VEXOS project timelines alongside the Visualization PM

• Scheduling and running client onboarding and training calls using provided materials

• Managing client communication after delivery — answering questions, logging change requests, and escalating issues to the right internal person

• Keeping project trackers, onboarding checklists, and documentation up to date

• Following established delivery SOPs and flagging when something is off-track

• Supporting the creation of training materials, guides, and client-facing documentation as directed

• Being the day-to-day client contact for active VEXOS accounts


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


What We're Looking For


Experience

• 2–4 years in a client-facing coordination, account support, or digital project management role

• Experience working with SaaS platforms, creative tech, or digital products is a plus

• Background in real estate or luxury industries is a bonus, not a requirement


Skills

• Exceptional written and spoken English — you will be communicating with US-based executive clients daily

• Comfortable learning and navigating new software platforms quickly

• Able to explain digital tools clearly to non-technical users

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail

• Responsive, professional, and calm under pressure

• Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift


Mindset

• You follow through. Every time.

• You communicate proactively — you don't go quiet when things get complicated

• You take pride in representing a premium brand to premium clients

• You're here to execute at a high level and grow with the company


━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

title: Gestor de Tráfego Pago - Junior / Pleno
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Somos um e-commerce de moda íntima feminina com 7anos de mercado. Investimento médio de 400-500k mês em mídia paga e faturamento de 8D ano.

Principais Atividades desempenhadas

  • Planejamento de Campanhas: Desenvolver estratégias de campanhas em plataformas de anúncios, alinhadas com os objetivos de marketing e vendas da empresa.
  • Automações com IA.
  • Execução de Campanhas: Criar, configurar e lançar campanhas de publicidade nas plataformas Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram), TikTok Ads e Pinterest Ads.
  • Realização de Testes A/B.
  • Subir testes de criativos semanalmente.
  • Fazer controle de Gastos Previsto x Realizado da Marca.
  • Pesquisa de Palavras Chaves e Segmentação.
  • Reuniões Semanais e Alinhamentos com a equipe de Marketing: Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de criação, conteúdo, para alinhar as estratégias e garantir coesão nas campanhas.
  • Realizar analise de contas e entregar relatórios de performance semanalmente e mensalmente.
  • Configuração de Pixel, tags de traqueamento e GTM se for necessário.


Como realmente vai ser sua rotina?

  • Subir campanhas de testes de criativo, ofertas de flash sales, captura de lead, conversão focada em eventos, novas estruturas, testes A/B, você irá apertar botões toda semana.
  • Analisar dados diariamente de todas as campanhas, conjuntos e anúncios ativos de todas as plataformas de mídia através das próprias plataformas e de ferramentas criadas internamente para facilitar a analise rápida.
  • Comunicação diária com time de Marketing (Estrategista Criativo, Head de Marketing, design e editor) para insights e direcionamento baseado no que está funcionando ou não nas contas, o que devemos continuar fazendo e o que não devemos continuar fazendo.



Requisitos OBRIGATÓRIOS!

  • Morar no RIO DE JANEIRO CAPITAL
  • Experiência comprovada EM E-COMMERCE com PROVA de resultados, obrigatório ter feito gestão de tráfego em E-COMMERCE.
  • Formação em Cursos da Área de Gestão e Marketing.
  • Já executa e estuda diariamente assuntos sobre IA (Claude, Claude CODE, agentes, etc)
  • Entendimento REAL sobre anúncios (Ganchos, ângulos, conceitos, dores, ICPs, formatos)


Informações gerais do cargo.

  • Inicio imediato
  • Sistema de Contrato PJ
  • Segunda a Sexta 09 às 18h.
  • Home Office
  • 1 Encontro presencial por trimestre.
  • Contrato de 30 dias de experiência.


O que oferecemos?

  • Day Off no mês de aniversário + Cupom Ifood 
  • Prêmios acumulativos por desempenho de R$150-200 reais.
  • Biblioteca de cursos da empresa de todas áreas do mercado. 
  • Gym Pass
  • Descanso Remunerado de 30 dias.
  • 1 pagamento a mais de bônus ao final do ano.

title: AI Video Producer (VEO3) for YouTube Ad Creative Agency
description:
About Us

We are a performance driven YouTube ad creative agency focused on producing high converting video ads for ecommerce brands.

Our team combines direct response strategy with cutting edge AI production workflows to create scalable video assets that drive measurable results.

We move fast, test aggressively, and continuously iterate on creative performance. Our focus is not on aesthetics alone, but on producing video content that converts and scales profitably.

We operate as a small, high performance team built around speed, ownership, and results.


Role Overview

We are hiring an AI Video Producer who specializes in generating high quality video content using AI tools such as VEO3, Kling, Heygen, and similar platforms.

You will be responsible for translating creative briefs into raw video assets by crafting effective prompts, iterating on outputs, and delivering production ready footage for our YouTube ad campaigns.

This role requires strong prompting skills, creative intuition, and the ability to consistently produce high quality outputs at scale.

You will work closely with creative strategists, editors, and AI workflows to bring ad concepts to life efficiently.


Key Responsibilities

Craft high quality prompts for VEO3, Kling, Heygen, and similar AI video tools to generate compelling video clips.

Produce raw video footage that aligns with creative briefs and direct response messaging.

Iterate on AI generated outputs to refine quality, consistency, and performance.

Translate written scripts and concepts into visual scenes using AI tools.

Collaborate with creative strategists and editors to ensure alignment on direction and deliverables.

Stay up to date with the latest AI video tools, prompting techniques, and workflows.

Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining speed and quality.

Optimize workflows to increase output efficiency and scalability.


Qualifications and Requirements

Experience using AI video tools such as VEO, Kling, Heygen, Runway, or similar.

Strong prompting ability with a clear understanding of how to control output quality and style.

Good visual sense and understanding of storytelling, pacing, and scene composition.

Ability to follow creative briefs and translate them into accurate visual outputs.

Experience working in a fast paced, performance driven environment.

Highly self directed with strong attention to detail.

Comfortable working with iterative workflows and rapid testing cycles.

Basic understanding of direct response marketing is a strong advantage.


Preferred Skills and Bonuses

Experience producing video creatives for YouTube or paid social ads.

Understanding of direct response frameworks and ad structures.

Experience working with ecommerce brands.

Familiarity with AI workflow automation and tools.

Experience collaborating with editors and creative teams.


What We Offer

Fully remote position.

Consistent workload with ongoing projects.

Opportunity to work with cutting edge AI tools.

Fast paced environment with rapid learning.

Clear growth path as the agency scales.

Performance driven culture focused on output and results.

title: Oracle PCM Architect
description:
About Auxis

Auxis is a U.S.-founded consulting and business outsourcing firm (est. 1997) that helps organizations optimize and transform their operations. We specialize in areas such as technology, finance, human resources, automation, and digital transformation.


About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Oracle PCM Architect to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of profitability and cost management solutions within the Oracle EPM Cloud ecosystem.

This role requires a strong mix of functional finance knowledge + technical EPM expertise, with ownership over solution architecture and client-facing delivery.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end solution design and architecture for Oracle PCM implementations
  • Define cost allocation models, driver-based costing, and profitability frameworks
  • Work closely with finance stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable solutions
  • Oversee data integrations, calculations, and model performance optimization
  • Ensure best practices in metadata design, hierarchies, and dimensional modeling
  • Support and guide teams during month-end and planning cycles
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across data, calculations, and reporting
  • Act as a technical leader and mentor for junior team members


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience with Oracle EPM, including strong exposure to PCM
  • Strong understanding of:
  • Cost allocation methodologies
  • Profitability analysis frameworks
  • Financial modeling and reporting
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Oracle PCMCS / EPCM
  • Smart View
  • Data Integration / Data Management
  • Metadata and hierarchy design


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in consulting or managed services environments
  • Exposure to multi-client / multi-project delivery
  • Oracle EPM certifications (nice to have)


Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset
  • Ability to communicate with both technical and finance stakeholders
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment


Work Expectations

  • Support North American business hours when required
  • Flexibility during planning and financial cycles
  • Ownership of delivery quality and SLAs

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Senior Financial Analyst


Location: Remote (Brazil)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support reporting, billing processes, and revenue operations. This role will play a critical part in ensuring financial accuracy, optimizing workflows, and delivering insights that drive business performance as the organization scales.



Position Overview


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to support financial operations, reporting, and billing processes. This role will act as a key partner across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success teams, ensuring alignment between contracts, invoicing, and revenue recognition. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with hands-on experience in billing, revenue operations, and financial reporting. This role requires both strategic insight and operational execution, contributing to process improvements and supporting the company’s financial health and scalability.



What You'll Do:


  • Analyze financial performance, identify trends, and deliver actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
  • Enhance financial reporting, tools, and processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
  • Ensure customer contracts are aligned with invoicing terms and revenue recognition policies
  • Prepare and process invoices accurately and in a timely manner, resolving discrepancies when needed
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure billing accuracy and proper contract implementation
  • Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments
  • Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documentation for audits and reporting
  • Contribute to optimizing and streamlining the quote-to-cash process
  • Support financial reporting cycles and assist with audits related to billing and revenue operations
  • Perform ad-hoc financial analysis and support additional finance-related initiatives.



What You Bring:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 4–7+ years of experience in financial analysis, billing, accounting, or revenue operations
  • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, revenue recognition principles, and financial reporting
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or financial systems is a plus
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • High attention to detail with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate financial data into clear, actionable insights.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with billing or subscription-based business models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process optimization and financial systems improvements
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • High-impact role supporting financial strategy and operations
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.


Please ensure that your application, including your CV, is submitted in English, as this is a requirement for the recruitment process.

title: Specialist Account Executive - Soluções Financeiras e Gestão
description:
Feita de pessoas que transformam a educação


Todas as vagas da Arco são elegíveis para Pessoas com Deficiência.

No dia a dia você irá:

  • Desenvolver conhecimento profundo sobre diversas áreas da empresa e os desafios do setor educacional;
  • Conduzir o funil de vendas de ponta a ponta, com foco em conversão e fechamento de grandes contas;
  • Negociar contratos complexos, muitas vezes envolvendo decisões financeiras relevantes para as escolas;
  • Criar e fortalecer relacionamento com gestores e decisores (diretores, mantenedores e C-Level), entendendo suas dores, desafios e motivações para propor soluções customizadas;
  • Manter o CRM atualizado em todas as etapas do funil;
  • Desenvolver ações criativas de engajamento para potencializar a jornada das escolas;
  • Identificar oportunidades de mercado e sugerir melhorias para evolução contínua do nosso produto.

Para participar do nosso processo você precisa ter:

  • Experiência sólida em vendas complexas e de funil longo (B2B, SaaS, ERP entre outros);
  • Familiaridade e gestão de funil de vendas;
  • Disponibilidade para muitas viagens em nível Brasil, sem restrições de deslocamento para cuidar de clientes em diferentes regiões;
  • Vontade de aprender e fazer parte de uma equipe vencedora, sabendo que somos mais fortes juntos e aceitando sair da zona de conforto;
  • Comunicação direta: ser uma pessoa comunicadora ativa e ouvinte atenta, que recebe feedbacks sinceros como oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Facilidade para lidar com mudanças constantes.
  • Senso de urgência, responsabilidade, organização e proatividade.

Diferenciais:

  • Ter atuado no mercado financeiro ou com produtos financeiros.

Declaração de Privacidade e Proteção de Dados

Quando você se candidata a uma das nossas vagas para ser isaacker, você nos fornece vários dados pessoais.

Ao final do processo seletivo, armazenamos o seu currículo em um banco de currículos, para o caso de surgirem novas vagas que tenham aderência ao seu perfil.

Para saber mais informações sobre como tratamos os seus dados e para exercer os seus direitos, acesse a nossa Declaração de Privacidade, disponível aqui.

Junte-se a nós!

O que você vai encontrar na Arco, além de pessoas incríveis:


+ Auxílio alimentação e/ou refeição

+ Plano de saúde e odontológico

+ Vale transporte

+ Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida

+ Auxílio creche

+ Cuidado com a saúde: parceria com a Wellhub e Zenklub

+ Incentivo à educação

+ Desconto em passagens aéreas

+ Parceria com plano de saúde para Pet

+ Acesso aos materiais didáticos Arco para filhos de colaboradores

+ Parcerias para MBA e Pós Graduação

#MaisDiversidade

Acreditamos que em um ambiente diverso e inclusivo nossas pessoas serão mais felizes, engajadas e com mais chances de atingir o seu máximo potencial . Por isso, aqui na Arco, respeitamos e valorizamos a igualdade de direito, reconhecemos as singularidades e acreditamos que todas as pessoas podem contribuir para o nosso propósito. #VemPraArco

  • Facilidade para lidar com mudanças constantes.
  • Senso de urgência, responsabilidade, organização e proatividade.

Diferenciais:

  • Ter atuado no mercado financeiro ou com produtos financeiros.

Declaração de Privacidade e Proteção de Dados

Quando você se candidata a uma das nossas vagas para ser isaacker, você nos fornece vários dados pessoais.

Ao final do processo seletivo, armazenamos o seu currículo em um banco de currículos, para o caso de surgirem novas vagas que tenham aderência ao seu perfil.

Para saber mais informações sobre como tratamos os seus dados e para exercer os seus direitos, acesse a nossa Declaração de Privacidade, disponível aqui.

Junte-se a nós!

O que você vai encontrar na Arco, além de pessoas incríveis:


+ Auxílio alimentação e/ou refeição

+ Plano de saúde e odontológico

+ Vale transporte

+ Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida

+ Auxílio creche

+ Cuidado com a saúde: parceria com a Wellhub e Zenklub

+ Incentivo à educação

+ Desconto em passagens aéreas

+ Parceria com plano de saúde para Pet

+ Acesso aos materiais didáticos Arco para filhos de colaboradores

+ Parcerias para MBA e Pós Graduação

#MaisDiversidade

Acreditamos que em um ambiente diverso e inclusivo nossas pessoas serão mais felizes, engajadas e com mais chances de atingir o seu máximo potencial . Por isso, aqui na Arco, respeitamos e valorizamos a igualdade de direito, reconhecemos as singularidades e acreditamos que todas as pessoas podem contribuir para o nosso propósito. #VemPraArco

  • Alinhamento: Estruturar estratégias pedagógicas com o time de ensino.

  • Organização: Capacidade de gerenciar bem o tempo, cumprir cronogramas de entrega e manter registros pedagógicos organizados;
  • Infraestrutura remota: Possuir computador próprio com bom desempenho para videochamadas e ferramentas de edição de texto/planilhas;

A Sprache&Wissen é uma EdTech que iniciou suas atividades no segmento de alemão, sendo atualmente a maior escola online de alemão do Brasil. Em 2023, expandimos para o Inglês com um curso especializado em aprendizagem acelerada. Administramos o Clube de Alemão, a Punkify, o Vale-inglês, a SWAI e a S&W Editora, com foco em harmonia, honestidade, agilidade, inovação, resiliência, confiabilidade e inteligência. Nossa missão é habilitar 100 mil brasileiros na fluência funcional do inglês até 2030.

title: Engenheiro de Software (Java) - Sênior
description:
Who We Are

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. For more than 25 years, DEXIAN® has been serving global clients across multiple industries, with the mission of attracting and retaining the world’s top talent.

Today, we are proudly recognized as one of the largest staffing augmentation companies in the United States by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). We are also a Minority-Owned Company, and we take pride in our strong commitment to diversity.

In Brazil, we have been operating since 2007 and have successfully partnered with more than 50 clients from different sectors of the economy.


What to Expect From Us

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.


About the Client

This position will support one of our clients, a global company focused in retail.


Key Responsibilities


  • Collaborates and pairs with other product team members (UX, engineering, and product management) to create secure, reliable, scalable software solutions
  • Writes custom code or scripts to automate infrastructure, monitoring services, and test cases
  • Writes custom code or scripts to do \"destructive testing\" to ensure adequate resiliency in production
  • Creates meaningful dashboards, logging, alerting, and responses to ensure that issues are captured and addressed proactively
  • Contributes to enterprise-wide tools to drive destructive testing, automation, or engineering empowerment
  • Identifies product enhancements (client-facing or technical) to create a better experience for the end users
  • Identifies unsecured code areas and implements fixes as they are discovered with or without tooling
  • Contributes to foundational code elements that can be reused many times by a product
  • Contributes to meaningful architecture diagrams and other documentation needed for security reviews or other interested parties
  • Defines Service Level Objectives for product(s) to constantly measure their reliability in production and help prioritize backlog work



Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years experience with Java 11 or above
  • Experience and understanding of what Lambda Expressions and Streams are in Java 8
  • SQL experience (BigQuery)
  • Understanding of ML concepts
  • Experience using Spring Boot
  • Must have experience developing microservices with Spring Boot
  • Experience developing applications that are hosted in the cloud – Home Depot uses GPC, but open to AWS or Azure experience
  • Experience with Kubernetes
  • Experience writing Junit test cases
  • 2+ years’ experience working in an Agile environment in 2 week sprints
  • Advanced English required



Additional Information

• 100% Remote position - Brazil

• Long-term / indefinite project

• CLT hiring model + benefits

• International team environment

title: LP Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across Latin America. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners throughout the region, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.


The ideal candidate is deeply embedded within the LATAM financial ecosystem, with a strong network of regional liquidity providers, banks, payment processors, OTC desks, and institutional partners. They should possess a strong understanding of local market structures, FX and payment flows, regulatory nuances, and banking infrastructure across key LATAM corridors.


Key Responsibilities:

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers across LATAM
  • Evaluate LP quality including pricing, depth, reliability, settlement capabilities, and regional coverage
  • Negotiate trading terms including spreads, fees, credit lines, settlement arrangements, and margin terms
  • Build strategic partnerships with local banks, payment providers, OTC desks, and institutional counterparties

Market & Network Development

  • Leverage an existing LATAM network to expand LP coverage across key markets including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and other emerging corridors
  • Maintain strong relationships with regional banks, payment providers, FX brokers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, regulatory developments, FX controls, pricing trends, and competitive landscape across LATAM
  • Provide local market intelligence and operational insight to support regional expansion and corridor development

Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, execution quality, and settlement efficiency for LATAM flows
  • Coordinate with internal compliance, operations, treasury, and onboarding teams to ensure smooth LP integration and operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring, optimization, and expansion of LP relationships across the region
  • Assist in identifying new liquidity opportunities tied to stablecoin adoption and cross-border payment demand in LATAM

Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate the opening of local bank accounts and establishment of payment rails required for LP operations in LATAM markets
  • Identify suitable banking and payment partners to support local currency settlement, cross-border flows, and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion
  • Support infrastructure setup for regional treasury operations, local collections, and payout capabilities

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, liquidity management, or institutional sales
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, digital assets, or related financial services
  • Deep understanding of LATAM financial markets, local banking systems, payment infrastructure, and regional liquidity dynamics
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, OTC desks, payment processors, and institutional partners across LATAM
  • Proven ability to source, onboard, and manage LPs within local LATAM markets
  • Strong knowledge of cross-border payment corridors, local currency settlement, and regional regulatory considerations
  • Must have a strong and established LP network in Latin America, with particular strength in one or more major regional markets
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferred


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement, and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption.

The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners, and cross-border corridors.

OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda, and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.


As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto, payments, and emerging market infrastructure to join us in shaping compliant, global payment rails for the next generation of cross-border finance.

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement, and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption.

The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners, and cross-border corridors.

OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda, and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.


As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto, payments, and emerging market infrastructure to join us in shaping compliant, global payment rails for the next generation of cross-border finance.

title: Analista Data Viz Sr.
description:
Esse(a) profissional será responsável por transformar dados em narrativas visuais claras, eficientes e orientadas ao negócio, indo além da construção de dashboards e garantindo que toda a jornada dos dados — desde as camadas analíticas até a visualização — seja confiável, performática e escalável.


O desafio envolve atuar com grandes volumes de dados em ambientes cloud, estruturando e preparando dados nas camadas analíticas (especialmente Silver e Gold), organizando métricas e regras de negócio, e construindo visualizações que realmente gerem valor para as áreas.


Buscamos alguém com forte pensamento analítico, domínio dos fundamentos de visualização de dados e experiência prática na preparação e modelagem de dados para consumo em BI. Mais do que dominar ferramentas específicas, esperamos alguém que entenda profundamente como dados se transformam em informação e decisão.


Como Analista de Data Visualization Sênior, você atuará em conjunto com times multidisciplinares, sendo a ponte entre dados e negócio, garantindo que as soluções analíticas sejam compreensíveis, confiáveis e acionáveis.


Se você gosta de contar histórias com dados, estruturar informações de forma inteligente e atuar próximo ao negócio para gerar impacto real, essa oportunidade é para você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desenvolver dashboards e produtos de dados focados em geração de insights e suporte à tomada de decisão.Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções visuais claras, intuitivas e eficientes.Atuar na preparação e transformação de dados nas camadas analíticas (Silver e Gold), garantindo qualidade e consistência.Modelar dados para consumo em ferramentas de BI, aplicando boas práticas de performance e escalabilidade.Definir e organizar métricas e KPIs em conjunto com as áreas de negócio, promovendo padronização.Aplicar princípios de Data Visualization (design, storytelling, hierarquia de informação, UX analítica).Otimizar dashboards e queries visando melhor performance e experiência do usuário.Garantir a qualidade dos dados utilizados nas visualizações por meio de validações e consistência lógica.Trabalhar em parceria com Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers e áreas de negócio.Documentar dashboards, métricas e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível.Apoiar na definição de boas práticas de visualização, modelagem e consumo de dados.Contribuir para a evolução da cultura data-driven na organização.

Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência sólida com Data Visualization, BI ou Analytics.Domínio dos fundamentos de visualização de dados (storytelling, design, percepção visual, UX).Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Power BI, Tableau e Looker .Conhecimento em modelagem de dados para consumo analítico.Domínio em SQL para exploração, transformação e validação de dados.Experiência com preparação de dados (ETL/ELT), especialmente em camadas analíticas (Silver e Gold).Conhecimento em linguagens das ferramentas de BI, como DAX e Linguagem M (Power BI).Familiaridade com ambientes de dados em cloud e conceitos de Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou Lakehouse.Capacidade de entender regras de negócio e traduzi-las em métricas e visualizações.Experiência com otimização de queries e performance de dashboards.Boa comunicação para interação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Requisitos desejáveis

Experiência com Python aplicado a análise e visualização de dados.


Conhecimento em frameworks de visualização interativa como Streamlit.


Experiência com construção de produtos de dados além de dashboards (apps analíticos, data products).


Vivência com grandes volumes de dados e ambientes distribuídos.


Conhecimento em versionamento de código e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Experiência com testes e validação de dados.


Remuneração CLT compatível com o mercado;

100% remoto;

title: Tech Lead - Ruby on Rails
description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Ruby on Rails Tech Lead to drive the technical direction of critical enterprise applications operating at a massive global scale. In this role, you will lead a high-performing engineering team focused on a complex and highly impactful domain: global electronic recyclables, inventory management, scheduling, transportation, and processing.

You will be at the forefront of designing and architecting robust, highly available web applications that integrate seamlessly across a vast internal ecosystem and with key external partners. Operating in an environment where performance, security, and scalability are non-negotiable, you will guide your team through complex technical challenges, ensuring our systems maintain uncompromising standards of data quality and integrity. If you thrive in a world-class engineering culture and have a passion for building sustainable, scalable solutions, this is the perfect opportunity to make a global impact.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership: Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of engineers, driving technical excellence, code quality, and best practices across the development lifecycle.
  • Architecture & Development: Lead the design, architecture, and feature development for existing and new scalable Ruby on Rails (Rails 6/7) applications.
  • System Optimization: Proactively troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to performance bottlenecks, response times, system capacity, and scalability limitations inherent in large-scale global ecosystems.
  • Complex Integrations: Architect and develop robust API integrations with 3rd-party vendors and a vast network of internal enterprise applications.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal business stakeholders, global technology resources (database, systems, networking, security), and external vendors to deliver seamless end-to-end solutions.
  • Domain Ownership: Drive the technical execution for the electronic recyclables domain, encompassing inventory tracking, logistics, and processing workflows.
  • Quality & Documentation: Maintain rigorous data quality, integrity, and consistency across the organization. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architectures, workflows, and websites.
  • Full-Stack Oversight: While focusing heavily on backend architecture, oversee and contribute to front-end (GUI) integration and development to ensure a flawless user experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven Leadership: Solid, hands-on experience leading and managing technical teams in a large-scale, fast-paced enterprise environment.
  • Ruby on Rails Mastery: 12+ years of overall software development experience, with a minimum of 10 years demonstrating expert-level knowledge of Ruby as a core language and the Ruby on Rails framework.
  • Advanced API Expertise: Extensive knowledge and practical experience in API design and interface technologies (JSON, ProtoBuf, REST, RPC, XML) at an enterprise scale.
  • Testing & CI/CD: Deep working knowledge of integrated testing frameworks (RSpec, MiniTest) and Continuous Integration suites (CircleCI, Jenkins) to maintain zero-downtime deployments and high code coverage.
  • Front-End Proficiency: Solid working knowledge of fundamental front-end development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, jQuery).
  • Education: 4-year degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent rigorous technical training program/bootcamp.
  • Language: Fluent English, with excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to global, cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Go (Golang) Experience: Hands-on development experience with Go is highly desirable for specific microservices and performance-critical components.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Experience deploying and scaling applications on AWS or similar enterprise cloud platforms.
  • Domain Knowledge: Previous experience working with supply chain, reverse logistics, inventory management, or sustainability/recycling systems.
  • Big Tech Experience: Prior experience working within the ecosystem of a massive, global technology company, understanding the nuances of enterprise-grade security, compliance, and global rollouts.

  • Domain Ownership: Drive the technical execution for the electronic recyclables domain, encompassing inventory tracking, logistics, and processing workflows.
  • Quality & Documentation: Maintain rigorous data quality, integrity, and consistency across the organization. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architectures, workflows, and websites.
  • Full-Stack Oversight: While focusing heavily on backend architecture, oversee and contribute to front-end (GUI) integration and development to ensure a flawless user experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven Leadership: Solid, hands-on experience leading and managing technical teams in a large-scale, fast-paced enterprise environment.
  • Ruby on Rails Mastery: 12+ years of overall software development experience, with a minimum of 10 years demonstrating expert-level knowledge of Ruby as a core language and the Ruby on Rails framework.
  • Advanced API Expertise: Extensive knowledge and practical experience in API design and interface technologies (JSON, ProtoBuf, REST, RPC, XML) at an enterprise scale.
  • Testing & CI/CD: Deep working knowledge of integrated testing frameworks (RSpec, MiniTest) and Continuous Integration suites (CircleCI, Jenkins) to maintain zero-downtime deployments and high code coverage.
  • Front-End Proficiency: Solid working knowledge of fundamental front-end development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, jQuery).
  • Education: 4-year degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent rigorous technical training program/bootcamp.
  • Language: Fluent English, with excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to global, cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Go (Golang) Experience: Hands-on development experience with Go is highly desirable for specific microservices and performance-critical components.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Experience deploying and scaling applications on AWS or similar enterprise cloud platforms.
  • Domain Knowledge: Previous experience working with supply chain, reverse logistics, inventory management, or sustainability/recycling systems.
  • Big Tech Experience: Prior experience working within the ecosystem of a massive, global technology company, understanding the nuances of enterprise-grade security, compliance, and global rollouts.

description:
US$ 1100 – 2800 por mês

Serviço oficial nas unidades militares das Forças Armadas da Ucrânia

  • Realizar tarefas de guarda e patrulha

  • Realizar tarefas de preparo de posições para defesa

  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares

  • Prestar assistência médica no nível de pelotão
  • Participar na evacuação de doentes e feridos para unidades médicas e entre as etapas de evacuação
  • Manter registros médicos de soldados feridos ou doentes
  • Implementar medidas preventivas para a saúde da unidade
  • Realizar treinamentos em medicina tática

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Ensino médio, técnico em saúde ou superior
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em zona de guerra
  • Aptidão para o serviço militar por questões de saúde
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Experiência militar será um diferencial
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

Condições

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares

Serviço oficial nas unidades militares das Forças Armadas da Ucrânia

Responsabilidades

  • Prestar assistência médica no nível de pelotão
  • Participar na evacuação de doentes e feridos para unidades médicas e entre as etapas de evacuação
  • Manter registros médicos de soldados feridos ou doentes
  • Implementar medidas preventivas para a saúde da unidade
  • Realizar treinamentos em medicina tática

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Ensino médio, técnico em saúde ou superior
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em zona de guerra
  • Aptidão para o serviço militar por questões de saúde
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Experiência militar será um diferencial
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

Condições

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares

US$ 1100 – 2800 por mês

Serviço oficial nas unidades militares das Forças Armadas da Ucrânia

Responsabilidades

  • Executar tarefas táticas
  • Deslocamentos à linha de frente
  • Realizar tarefas de preparo de posições para defesa
  • Manter e controlar a condição técnica das armas

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Treinamento militar ou experiência relevante será um diferencial
  • Conhecimento de táticas de combate e experiência com metralhadoras será um diferencial
  • Boa aptidão física e resistência
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e agir sob risco elevado
  • Disponibilidade para atuar por longos períodos no campo
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em zona de guerra
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

Condições

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares

title: Software Developer (Android Payment)
description:
BRAZILIAN-PORTUGUESE VERSION

DESENVOLVEDOR ANDROID DE SOFTWARE DE PAGAMENTO


Desenvolvimento de software de pagamento, ou módulos para software de pagamento, em terminais Android, seguindo especificações ou requisitos dos clientes ou padrões definidos por entidades reguladoras como ABECS, bem como acompanhar o processo de integração até que a certificação seja concluída. Com base nos produtos entregues pela área central de P&D (R&D) e guiado pelo processo do ciclo de vida do projeto do cliente, o desenvolvedor de software desempenhará um papel fundamental na entrega do projeto.


RESPONSABILIDADES CHAVE

  • Analisar e compreender as especificações de requisitos do cliente.
  • Participar da fase de estudo técnico e design em colaboração com o gerente de projeto e outras partes interessadas técnicas.
  • Propor melhorias para os produtos existentes, estruturas de desenvolvimento e melhores práticas para aprimorar a qualidade e a eficiência do software.
  • Definir a estratégia de implementação — incluindo estimativa de custos e planejamento — em coordenação com o gerente de projeto do cliente e o líder técnico (se aplicável).
  • Desenvolver módulos de software de acordo com as especificações aprovadas, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos, metas de custo e processos de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Preparar e executar testes unitários e fornecer documentação detalhada para os módulos desenvolvidos.
  • Contribuir para a fase de homologação, apoiando os testes e a validação com o cliente.
  • Fornecer suporte de Nível 3 para soluções personalizadas em produção, trabalhando com as equipes de suporte regionais e globais, conforme necessário.
  • Atuar como especialista técnico quando necessário, oferecendo conhecimento e orientação de alto nível a clientes e equipes internas.
  • Demonstrar flexibilidade no gerenciamento de múltiplos projetos e na transição entre diferentes soluções ou tecnologias, conforme necessário.
  • Knowledge of security, cryptography, and card protocols will be considered a plus.


REQUISITOS DE QUALIFICAÇÃO E FORMAÇÃO

  • Diploma/Universidade: Engenharia ou Ciência da Computação e áreas afins.
  • 5 anos de experiência em funções similares (experiência no setor de Pagamentos, Automação Financeira ou de Varejo)
  • Inglês é um diferencial.
  • Diploma/Universidade: Engenharia ou Ciência da Computação e áreas afins.
  • 5 anos de experiência em funções similares (experiência no setor de Pagamentos, Automação Financeira ou de Varejo)
  • Inglês é um diferencial.


ENGLISH VERSION

Software development for payment processing, or modules for payment processing, on Android devices, following client specifications or requirements or standards defined by regulatory bodies such as ABECS, as well as monitoring the integration process until certification is completed. Based on the products delivered by the central R&D area and guided by the client's project lifecycle process, the software developer will play a key role in project delivery.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Analyse and understand customer requirement specifications.
  • Participate in the technical study and design phase in collaboration with the project manager and other technical stakeholders.
  • Propose enhancements to the existing products, development frameworks, and best practices to improve software quality and efficiency.
  • Define the implementation strategy—including cost estimation and planning—in coordination with the customer project manager and technical lead (if applicable).
  • Develop software modules in line with approved specifications, ensuring adherence to timelines, cost targets, and software development processes.
  • Prepare and execute unit tests and provide detailed documentation for the developed modules.
  • Contribute to the homologation phase by supporting testing and validation with the customer.
  • Provide Level 3 support for live custom solutions, working with the regional and global support teams as necessary.
  • Act as a technical expert when required, offering high-level expertise and guidance to customers and internal teams.
  • Demonstrate flexibility in handling multiple projects and transitioning between different solutions or technologies as required.
  • Knowledge of security, cryptography, and card protocols will be considered a plus.


QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Diploma/University: Computer Engineering or Science and similar
  • 5-year experience in similar functions (experience in the industry of Payments, Financial or Retail Automation)
  • English is a differentiator.

project management experience is a plus.

4.Fluent in English, able to conduct in-depth business communication independently;
proficiency in a secondforeign language is a plus.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
ompany Overview:

Anker Innovations is a global leader in charging technology and a developer of consumer electronics and smart devices. We are committed to bringing innovative products to our customers and ensuring the highest standards of quality and service. As we expand our presence in Latam, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced Channel Specialist to join our team


Key Responsibilities:

As a Channel Specialist, you will be the cornerstone of our channel expansion and management efforts in Brazil. Your core duties will include:

  • Project Coordination & Lead Management: Take ownership of the regional distributor recruitment project by collecting, organizing, and managing all distributor leads generated by our sales advisors.
  • Distributor Screening & Onboarding: Conduct preliminary screenings of potential distributors based on established criteria, proactively contact and qualify candidates in target regions, and build a structured pipeline. You will collaborate with our headquarters team to finalize the selection of new distributors.

This includes facilitating orders, managing procurement processes, monitoring sales targets, and ultimately being accountable for the sales performance and revenue growth within your channel.


Qualifications:

We are looking for a proactive and results-driven professional with:

  • Language Skills: Full professional proficiency in both Portuguese and English is mandatory.
  • Experience: 3-5 years of relevant experience in sales, channel management, or key account management.
  • Industry Knowledge: Prior experience in the consumer electronics industry is highly preferred.
  • Cultural Affinity: Experience working with or for a Chinese company is a significant advantage.
  • Personal Attributes: A self-starter with a strong sense of initiative, excellent resilience under pressure, and a genuine enthusiasm for embracing change and challenges. You must be a quick learner who can rapidly apply new knowledge to your work.


We Offer:

  • A pivotal role in the expansion of a globally recognized and beloved brand.
  • A dynamic, fast-paced, and supportive international work environment.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
